sets.title: Demo: A changed appointment
sets.directions: Read the message and choose the best answer.

stimulus.text: The supplier can still meet us on Tuesday, but only after 3 p.m. If that is too late, she has offered Thursday morning instead. Please let me know which option causes less disruption to the production team.

items.question: What does the writer want the reader to do?
items.explanationZh: 訊息提供星期二下午與星期四上午兩個時間，並請收件者選擇較不影響生產團隊的選項。

distractorRationales.C: 沒有要求生產團隊提早完成。

sets.title: Demo: Library notice
sets.directions: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.

stimulus.text: The library will remain open during renovation, although visitors are advised to use the side entrance.

items.question: Visitors are advised ___ the side entrance.
items.explanationZh: advise someone to do something 是固定結構。

distractorRationales.B: 此處不是 advise + 動名詞。
